Done. Saved a new skill and cross-linked it.

What was generalizable here: OfficeQA has two distinct "geometric mean" question types that demand opposite handling:

- Raw LEVEL values (this question — silver production in fine ounces): plain geometric mean, G = (∏x)^(1/n), no factor conversion.
- Growth RATES (percent changes): must convert to (1+r/100) factors first.

Applying the wrong method to either is catastrophic. I created officeqa-geometric-mean-raw-levels documenting the raw-level path (with the disambiguation rule, inclusive-endpoint N counting, no-rescale/no-intermediate-rounding pitfalls, and this PASSED example) and patched the existing growth-rates skill with a pointer at the top so a future agent classifies correctly before computing.

No memory entry needed — the skills carry it and memory is near full.
